blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Good feedback is short and kind. A quick "Great job!" or "Well done!" can light up the day. These small words help teams work well and feel happy.

Today you learn five simple words: good, great, thanks, well done, and proud. You can use them every day at work, with your team and your friends.

You do not need long sentences. "Good job!" is enough. Say it, smile, and your team feels great. Step by step, you can do it. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts.

items.q: What can a quick "Great job!" do?
items.why: "A quick 'Great job!' or 'Well done!' can light up the day."

items.q: How many new words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn five simple words: good, great, thanks, well done, and proud."

items.q: Good feedback is…
items.why: "Good feedback is short and kind."

items.q: Which idea would the author most likely DISAGREE with?
options: You need long sentences to give good feedback.
Small words can help a team.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "You do not need long sentences" — o autor discorda dessa ideia.

items.q: "Teams work well and feel happy" suggests that kind words…
items.why: Inferência: palavras gentis ajudam o time a trabalhar bem e a se sentir feliz.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie dando feedback positivo numa reunião curta de equipe. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi team. Thank you all for coming today. I have good news for you. This week was great. You worked very hard, and it shows in the results.

Ana, well done on the report. It was clear, short, and good. Thank you for your help this week. And Tom, great job with the new client. They are very happy with you. That is not easy, so well done.

I am proud of this team. You are doing well every day. When we work together, we do great work. Small words help a lot. A quick "thanks" or "good job" makes people smile.

So please, keep going. Say thank you to each other. Say well done when a friend does good work. Be kind and help your team. This is how we grow.

Next week we start a new project. It is new, but I am not worried. We are a strong team, and we can do it, step by step. Thank you all again. Great work, everybody. Have a good day!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Why is Sophie happy this week?
options: There is a new client every day
items.why: "This week was great. You worked very hard, and it shows in the results."

items.q: What did Ana do well?
items.why: "Ana, well done on the report."

items.q: Who worked with the new client?
items.why: "And Tom, great job with the new client."

items.q: Sophie would most likely agree that…
options: only the boss can say thanks
feedback is a waste of time
long emails are the best feedback
small kind words help the team
items.why: Inferência: ela diz que "Small words help a lot" e pede que todos digam obrigado e well done.

items.q: How does Sophie feel about the new project next week?
options: Confident — the team can do it
items.why: Inferência: "It is new, but I am not worried. We are a strong team, and we can do it."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "You did a good job today." Good means…
items.why: Good = bom, bem feito.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "___ work, team! I really love it."
items.why: Great work = ótimo trabalho; combina com "I really love it".

items.q: "Thanks a lot for your help." Thanks means…
items.why: Thanks = obrigado(a).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Well ___, Ana! You finished the report."
items.why: Well done = muito bem; é a expressão certa para elogiar.

items.q: "I am so proud of you." Proud means…
items.why: Proud = orgulhoso(a): feliz com o bom resultado de alguém.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples para dar feedback e elogiar no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Keep it up, team! You are doing great." Keep it up means…
items.why: Keep it up = continue assim, mantenha o bom trabalho.

items.q: "The boss gave Ana a pat on the back." A pat on the back is…
items.why: A pat on the back = um elogio, reconhecimento por um bom trabalho.

items.q: "Well done on the project!" Well done means…
items.why: Well done = muito bem, você fez um bom trabalho.

items.q: "She gave me a thumbs up after the meeting." A thumbs up means…
items.why: Thumbs up = joinha, sinal de aprovação ("tudo certo / bom").

items.q: "Let's give Tom a big shout-out for his help." A shout-out is…
items.why: Shout-out = um agradecimento ou elogio público a alguém.
